quests.title: Trouble With Letters

dialogue.t: *sigh* What shall I do...
You must have seen those meteorites that fell from the sky as well, right? Fortunately, the city wasn't hit, but it's a real mess out there in the wild.

Not only have the meteorites blocked the roads, but they've also caused the nearby monsters to become more agitated and dangerous than usual, and they've been attacking passers-by and merchants everywhere.
The Ministry of Civil Affairs has sent almost every single available Millelith out, but Liyue is far too large. We can only ensure the safety of a few main roads and some key villages.
I'd applied to go to Qingce Village to take up guard duties there, but for some reason, I still got redeployed here to stand by for orders...
Traveler, could you help me send this letter to a girl named Little Liu who lives in Qingce Village?
She's my daughter, and I'd agreed to go back to spend a few days with her. But with this emergency cropping up, there's no way that'll happen now...
Much appreciated, Traveler. Ah, what horrible luck...
That said, I've heard from people who've come to stand down from duty that quite a few monsters have gathered near Qingce Village as well.
Well... I don't mean to impose, but you do look dressed for adventure.
Could you have a look around Qingce Village while you're sending the letter, and help to clear the monsters out?
The Millelith largely stand guard on the main roads and key passes... Things could go poorly if some scattered monsters were able to sneak into Qingce Village.
Thank you! I truly appreciate it.
*sigh* When will I finally be able to clear my leave...

dialogue.sit: Any idea where Little Liu is?

dialogue.t: Little Liu? Hmm, I remember her saying that she wanted to find a high place so she could watch the meteorites...
Hmm, I think she <color=#00E1FFFF>climbed up those ladders over there</color>.

dialogue.sit: Do you where Little Liu is?

dialogue.t: Little Liu? We were going to meet here to watch the meteorites, but she said that she wanted to find someplace higher.
She said that she'd tell me once she found our new spot, but I don't know where she's gone.
Little Liu... Little Liu... Ah yes, I know her. But I've been here all this while, and she didn't pass this way.
I should be able to see the meteorites clearly from here...
A letter from Daddy... Ugh, I already know what it's going to say...
He can't come and spend time with me because of work, right?
When those Millelith came here, I thought Daddy would be with them, but that didn't happen...
But that's not a bad thing, actually. With all those rocks falling from the sky, Daddy could be in danger out there.
Well... a little, but we should be alright. The Millelith are here, after all.
Right! Could you send this letter back to Daddy for me? He must be worried.
It's so strange. Something seems to happen every time Daddy says he'll take leave and spend time with me...
That's so weird. Why does something happen every time Daddy applies for leave?
You're back. Did you manage to deliver the letter?

dialogue.sit: I did. Little Liu has a letter for you too, by the by.

dialogue.t: Little Liu wrote me a letter? Let me see...
Thank you, Traveler. I'll keep this for the time being. This is not the time to be reading letters... I must attend to my duties now.
Please take this as compensation for your trouble.
Once this is all over, I'm taking a long break for sure...

quests.description: Due to the meteor shower, Jiayi’s plans to return home to see his family have been canceled yet again. He is looking for someone to send a letter to Qingce Village…
